sources.title: Bard — Official Final Fantasy d20 class
Bard Song Talents — Official Final Fantasy d20

issues.reason: Bard songs and jingles are not yet extracted into a selectable options catalog. Levels/song restrictions and CHA-gated choices must be implemented before character saving.

The 32 standard and 12 advanced Song Talents are extracted with tier, repeat, class feature prerequisites and the Bardic Inspiration die upgrade. Wizard selection/validation and the Bard save adapter still require implementation; advanced talents consume existing even-level slots.
Performance actions, targets, ongoing effects, aura ranges, saving throws and resources remain manual descriptions; not permanent sheet bonuses.
Versatile Performance has specialty-specific substitution and advanced options; choice UI and dependency checks are not implemented.
Bard runtime adapter for CHA song MP, casting, skill points and upgrades not yet written. Staged display only.
Bard archetypes are index-only; each must be extracted separately.

features.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
features.description: Simple weapons and harp bows; light armor, no shields. Light armor does not cause song failure.

features.name: Limit Breaks
features.description: Siren's Song and Soul Voice are the Bard Limit Breaks; shared Limit Break rules apply.

features.name: Siren's Song
features.description: Swift-action Limit Break; songs ignore sound-blocking and distorting effects for a level-scaled duration.

features.name: Soul Voice
features.description: Swift-action Limit Break; one song started each round has its variables maximized and doubled for a level-scaled duration.

features.name: Songs
features.description: Charisma-based songcasting using MP; learn 3 + CHA modifier first-level songs at creation and two more per Bard level; maintained-song constraints apply.

features.name: Jingles
features.description: Learn two 0-level songs at first level, +1 every four Bard levels thereafter; no MP cost.

features.name: Musical Power
features.description: Ranged touch performance attack, using Perform ranks in place of BAB, dealing 1d4 + CHA damage; 25 ft + 5 ft per two levels.

features.name: Bardic Performance
features.description: 4 + CHA modifier rounds/day at level 1; +2 rounds per subsequent level. Start as standard action, becoming move at 7 and swift at 13.

features.name: Countersong
features.description: Maintain a performance against sonic and language-dependent effects, allowing an affected ally to substitute an appropriate Perform result.

features.name: Distraction
features.description: Maintain a performance that defends allies from illusion effects using an appropriate Perform result.

features.name: Fascinate
features.description: Maintain a performance against visible, hearing creatures, with level-based target count; Will save ends effect and blocks repeated attempts for 24 hours.

features.name: Inspire Courage
features.description: Active performance buffs allies' attacks, weapon damage and saves against charm/fear; starts at +1 and scales to +4.

features.name: Versatile Performance
features.description: Choose one Perform specialty to substitute its total bonus for associated skills; choose additional specialty or advanced alternative at levels 6,10,14,18.

features.name: Well-Versed
features.description: +4 on saving throws versus bardic performance, sonic and language-dependent effects.

features.name: Song Talents
features.description: Select one song talent at every even Bard level. From level 12, advanced options become eligible in place of a normal talent.

features.name: Inspire Competence
features.description: Active performance boosts an ally's skill check by +2 at level 3, improving every four Bard levels to +6 at 19; cannot target self.

features.name: Inspiration
features.description: Move-action morale encouragement grants allies temporary HP, beginning at 1d6 and adding 1d6 per two class levels; 3 + CHA modifier uses/day.

features.name: Medley
features.description: Maintain two songs at once starting at level 4, increasing to five songs by level 16; additional Perform checks required.

features.name: Wide Audience
features.description: Choose a 60-foot cone instead of 30-foot radius; appropriate song area or target count scales every four levels.

features.name: Clear Mind
features.description: Recover Bard MP while relaxed and awake, initially 1 MP per hour; improves every five Bard levels.

features.name: Suggestion
features.description: Use a standard action to suggest an action to an already fascinated creature; Will DC 10 + half Bard level + CHA modifier.

features.name: Skilled Performer
features.description: Gain a bonus for Perform skill points (+5 at 7, +10 at 13, +15 at 19), allocated among Perform specialties; not general skill points.

features.name: Dirge of Doom
features.description: While performing, eligible enemies within 30 ft become shaken (never directly frightened/panicked).

features.name: Inspire Greatness
features.description: Performance grants temporary bonus Hit Dice and combat bonuses to a willing ally, with target count scaling at 12,15,18.

features.name: Soothing Performance
features.description: Four-round performance applies Cura-like healing and removes fatigue, sickness and shaken from affected creatures.

features.name: Advanced Song Talents
features.description: Advanced options become selectable instead of a normal Song Talent at levels 12,14,16,18,20. Not a second free talent.

features.name: Can't Stop My Performance
features.description: Immune to silence and blindness effects per class text.

features.name: Frightening Tune
features.description: Active performance can frighten hearing enemies within 30 feet; successful Will save blocks repeat for 24 hours.

features.name: Inspire Heroics
features.description: Active performance grants +4 morale to saves and +4 dodge to AC to eligible allies while maintained.

features.name: Unstoppable Performance
features.description: Bardic performances can affect blind and deaf creatures without penalty.

features.name: Adoring Fan
features.description: Performance can dominate a failed-save listener temporarily, followed by a charm effect; target gains 24-hour protection on successful save.

features.name: 1 MP Song
features.description: Three times daily, reduce next song's MP cost to 1 after metasong adjustments.

features.name: Funeral Ballad
features.description: Once/day, a 10-round performance can restore a dead creature using an Arise-like effect.

features.name: Deadly Performance
features.description: Performance may kill a single creature after a Will save; success instead dazes target and prevents repeat for 24 hours.

features.name: Master Bard
features.description: Song/performance DCs +2; once/day start up to five Medley songs with one standard action and no Perform checks.
